markets.marketGuide: Which team will win the match. If your team leads by 2 goals at any time, it will be considered a winner. Regular time only. * Bet on Home. The bet wins if Home wins but will be paid out early if Home leads by 2 goals at any time. * Bet on Draw. The bet wins if the match ends in a Draw. * Bet on Away. The bet wins if Away wins but will be paid out early if Away leads by 2 goals at any time.
markets.name: 1X2 - 2UP

markets.marketGuide: Never Down will reward you if your team wins the match without ever trailing. If your team goes one or more goals behind at any point, the selection loses, even if they later come back to win. If you bet on Draw, the bet wins if the match ends in a Draw (Regular 1X2). If a match is abandoned after a team goes behind, bets on that selection will be settled as lost. SportyBet reserves the right to void selections in cases of identified integrity issues or abusive behaviour.
markets.name: 1X2 - Never Down
